proposals.title: REPORT ON EFFECTIVENESS OF SOCIAL COMPLIANCE EFFORTS IN TJX'S SUPPLY CHAIN
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan and the Sisters of St. Dominic
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party assessment and report on the effectiveness of due diligence in preventing forced, child, and prison labor in TJX's supply chain.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: REPORT ON RISK TO TJX FROM SUPPLIER MISCLASSIFICATION OF SUPPLIER'S EMPLOYEES
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on financial, reputational, and human rights risks from supply chain and distribution companies misclassifying employees as independent contractors.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: REPORT ON RISK DUE TO RESTRICTIONS ON REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management, LLC and Zevin Asset Management, LLC
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on risks and costs to the company from state policies restricting reproductive rights, and mitigation strategies beyond litigation.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: PAID SICK LEAVE POLICY FOR ALL ASSOCIATES
proposals.proponent: Figure 8 Investment Strategies on behalf of the Revocable Trust of Ellen E. Bush
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to adopt and publicly disclose a paid sick leave policy covering all part-time and full-time employees, not expiring or tied to a pandemic.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 8.
